title: Zombie Siege 3D
description: Fortify a 3D outpost surrounded by swarms of undead—deploy traps, upgrade defensive towers, and mow down wave after wave of zombies closing in from every angle.
controls: Drag to move your defender around the base, collect resources, and step on build zones to upgrade walls, traps, and firepower.

zh-CN.title: 僵尸围城
zh-CN.description: 高燃 3D 尸潮围城防守：在四面受敌的末日据点架起喷火塔、锯片陷阱和机枪阵地，硬扛一波波狂暴尸潮！
zh-CN.controls: 滑动屏幕控制角色巡防与射击，收集资源升级城墙、陷阱与防御塔抵御僵尸围攻。
